column1: Yandy Diaz stands out as the top pick with a strong hit probability, batting leadoff at home with the platoon advantage and a favorable park factor. Diaz has recorded a hit in over 70% of his games this season, offering a high level of consistency against Brady Basso. Trea Turner is also reliable atop the order with a similar matchup edge, while Alec Burleson brings a recent hot streak but slightly less overall steadiness.
